preconditions.description: Lengths of s and t are within the specified range.
The lengths of s and t match the given n and m.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in s) and ('*' in s or all(c.islower() for c in s))
preconditions.description: String s consists of lowercase Latin letters and at most one wildcard character '*'.
String t consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES' if any(s[:i] + s[i+1:] == t[:len(s)-1] for i in range(len(s)) if s[i] == '*') else return_value == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if there exists a position in s where replacing '*' with a substring of t results in t, otherwise 'NO'.
